rules.accepted_credit_types: Seminars, workshops or courses enhancing social work practice (incl. related cross-disciplinary offerings and employer in-service training); academic social work or related courses (1 credit = 15 h); first-time presentation (max 10 h); first publication (max 10 h); independent home study/online (max 15 h). The Board does not pre-approve workshops.
rules.audit_note: After each renewal period the Board audits a percentage of renewals; keep documentation 2 years after the renewal date.
rules.notes: No more than 15 hours of independent study; webinars count as face-to-face only if live and interactive. The same course may not be counted twice in one renewal period. Licenses are issued for two-year periods.
rules.legal_basis: Ark. Code Ann. §17-103-304; Arkansas Social Work Licensing Board Rules VIII-IX
